_comment: SIT query set for sit/corpus. Each case passes when a chunk of `expect` is within the top `within` citations (default 3). `forbid_top` is a source that must NOT be the #1 hit. `known_gap` cases are reported as GAP and do not fail the run. On every response, sit_check also asserts that each citation has metadata.tenant == --tenant (default brightcart), has status active, and comes from neither acme-returns nor draft-no-tenant.

cases._note: Tenant isolation: worded like acme-returns, which belongs to tenant acme and must never be returned to a brightcart key.

cases.query: returns in December until 31 January holiday

cases._note: Near-duplicate edge case: the archived 2024 policy must not outrank the current one. The 2024 doc is `status: archived`, so retrieval must exclude it (before that change it ranked #1 at 0.545).
